Name the method

Ten short problems, each with four methods from the guide. Choose the one that solves it; you do not have to solve it. Nothing tells you which unit a problem is from until you have chosen, which is how an exam asks. A wrong first choice shows you what that method is for, and you choose again.

Or one unit All 12345678910
